name: Craft Academy
description: Warm workshop-style site for an online woodworking course, with a scroll-drawn learning path and flip-over module cards.
features: Eight-module learning path whose SVG line draws through each node as you scroll
Flip cards that turn over to reveal every lesson in a module
Instructor bio, three enrolment packages and student reviews
FAQ accordion and an enquiry form with a package selector
signature: A curriculum path line draws itself through module nodes on scroll; module cards flip to show their lesson lists
